newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Eltin shares slide to 10 month low.
newsitem.headline: Eltin shares slide to 10 month low.

text.p: Shares in contract miner Eltin Ltd dived over nine percent to a 10 month low of A$2.25 on Thursday following a profit warning on Wednesday.
The company said its second half results would be similar to those of the first half. Previously, the company was forecasting a higher second half profit.
Eltin cited problems at the Refugio gold mine in Chile and a deteriorating performance at the Mt Leyshon gold mine in Western Australia.

"The announcement yesterday is the reason. The market was looking some growth out of the stock but instead the earnings are going to be flat because of the problems at Refugio," said a Melbourne-based broker.
By 11.40 a.m. (0140 GMT), Eltin shares were 16.4 cents lower at A$2.32 on turnover of 127,148 shares.
